category_rationale: Processing and enhancing crime scene photography for forensic clarity requires specialized editing software.

do_nothing_test.note: Neither enhanced_evidence.png nor evidence_comparison.png exist. Returns score=0 immediately.

partial_test.example: Agent enhances the photo and exports only enhanced_evidence.png (not comparison). Criteria 1 and 2 pass; criteria 3 (comparison missing), 4, 5 fail. Score=40%.

verification_criteria.label: enhanced_evidence.png exists and is valid
verification_criteria.check: File exists on Desktop, PIL can open it

verification_criteria.label: Enhanced image brighter/higher contrast than source
verification_criteria.check: Output brightness mean > source + 10, OR output contrast range > source + 10

verification_criteria.label: evidence_comparison.png exists and is valid
verification_criteria.check: File exists on Desktop, PIL can open it

verification_criteria.label: Comparison layout is side-by-side (wider than source)
verification_criteria.check: Comparison image width ≥ 1.5× source image width

verification_criteria.label: Comparison halves are distinct
verification_criteria.check: Left half mean brightness vs right half mean brightness differ by > 5

source_image.subject: Historical photograph with naturally low brightness/contrast

gimp_features_required: Filters → Enhance → Despeckle or Gaussian Blur (noise reduction)
Image → Canvas Size (to create wider comparison canvas)
Layer operations: duplicate, copy, paste, position
validation_notes: Task statically validated. The comparison layout criterion is strictly verifiable: a side-by-side image must be approximately 2× the source width. The two halves having different brightness is reliable since one is original (dark) and one is enhanced (brighter). This task requires the most complex layer operations of the 5 tasks.
